note: ORPHAN Pro 25:6 — do not put yourself forward in the king's presence or stand in the place of the great.

dims.v: presumptuous self-advancement — pushing oneself forward before the king

the putting of oneself forward in the king's presence, claiming the place of the great — the presumptuous self-advancement that grasps at honour ungiven, the pride that seats itself high only to risk being told to come down
the self-thrusting ambition that grabs at status before the great

hadar (honour / exalt oneself) — 'do not put YOURSELF FORWARD in the king's presence' (25:6); self-promotion before the great is folly and pride. Better to be raised than to grab the high place and be lowered (25:7; cf Luke 14:8-10). Humility waits to be called up.
